item.title: Solved: Key Differences Between VARCHAR and TEXT in MySQL
item.description:
Selecting between VARCHAR and TEXT data types in MySQL can have significant implications for database performance and storage efficiency. This article provides an in-depth look at the differences between these two types, along with practical recommendations for choosing the best option.

What’s the Difference Between VARCHAR and TEXT in MySQL?

When creating tables in MySQL, developers often need to store string data. VARCHAR and TEXT are two common data types for this purpose, but they differ in how they handle storage, indexing, and maximum lengths.
